theme: Coloring a surface mesh with a proof
title: Wheel Mesh Coloring with Obstruction Certificates
strategies: component-siloed baseline: color each disjoint patch with a fresh, never-reused block of colors, cost-blind, no certificates (reproduces the checker baseline)
textbook first-fit greedy in raw vertex order, cost-blind, never explains its color count

wheel-aware strong solution: detect each local hub+rim wheel from the raw graph, walk the rim to 2-color it (flip the odd-cycle seam vertex to a 4th color exactly when needed), reuse the globally cheapest 3/4-color palette across every wheel, and emit an obstruction certificate for every odd wheel found
